APEN REVIEW — TERMS & CONDITIONS AND PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: 29 October 2026

Apen Review is developed and provided by Apenkoder Software, a registered business name in Kenya (Business No. BN-J9S6EO27), P.O. Box 69587-00400, Nairobi, Kenya. By using this app, you agree to the terms below.

R3 BUSINESS RECORDS AND SHARING
Corrections and removals retain original values in local change history. New encrypted backups include personal loan notes; R1 backups did not. Statements contain self-recorded aggregate figures, not independently verified information or a credit score. Preview each statement and choose whether to save or share it. Inuka does not receive records automatically. Apen cannot confirm receipt or lender acceptance, or recall a sent file.

1. WHAT THIS APP DOES
Apen helps owners of dairy farms, rental property, small food businesses and retail shops keep local business records. Each business has its own home screen, vocabulary, accounts and records. Owners can switch between businesses without mixing their records. A whole-app backup contains all businesses and personal loan notes. Loans and plans are information and personal records only; Apen does not apply for, approve or process a loan.

2. YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
Apen keeps business records and personal notes in local app storage. You choose whether to create an encrypted backup or save or share a statement, and where that file goes. Statements contain aggregate business figures and omit individual customer, buyer and tenant names, phone numbers and payment references. Apenkoder Software and Inuka do not receive your records automatically. Apen has no cloud synchronization or automatic lender reporting. Any future cloud feature would require updated information and appropriate choices before transmission.

3. BACKUPS ARE YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
Because your data lives only on this device, the following will permanently delete it unless you have made a backup:
• Clearing the app's data or storage
• Uninstalling the app
• Losing, damaging, resetting, or replacing your device
The app lets the owner create a password-protected backup file in Backup and save it wherever they choose, for example Google Drive, WhatsApp or a memory card, and restore it later. Apenkoder Software does not receive, store or hold copies of your backups and cannot recover them, and cannot open a backup if its password is forgotten. Apenkoder Software is not responsible for any data loss, including from a lost or forgotten backup password. You are responsible for making backups regularly and keeping them safe.

4. PAYMENTS ARE RECORDS ONLY
Selecting a payment method records how a sale was paid for, or records an amount owed when Deni (Credit) is selected. The simple interface offers Cash, M-Pesa, Deni and part payments with the unpaid balance recorded as Deni. Quantities may be pieces, weight or volume. Airtel Money and Card remain in the complete interface.
For mobile-money records, you enter the confirmation code from the customer's payment message. The app checks the entered reference, including whether it has already been used in this app. The app does not verify, process, send, or receive any actual money, and does not contact Safaricom, Airtel, any card network, or any other payment provider. You are responsible for confirming that payment was received.
M-Pesa and Airtel Money are services of Safaricom PLC and Airtel Africa respectively; Apenkoder Software is not affiliated with either company, and your use of those services is governed by their own separate terms.

5. YOUR RESPONSIBILITY FOR ACCURACY
All sales, stock levels, prices, customer balances, and expenses you see in this app are only as accurate as what you enter. Apenkoder Software is not responsible for business, financial, or tax decisions you make based on figures recorded in this app. The business name, phone number and KRA PIN printed on receipts are exactly what you enter; you are responsible for their accuracy and for meeting your own tax and receipting obligations. We recommend keeping your own separate records for any official, tax, loan, or Sacco reporting purposes.

6. WHO CAN USE THIS APP
This owner-review interface is intended for adults operating or managing the supported businesses. You must be at least 18 years old to use Apen Review. The owner signs in using a local username and PIN, and is responsible for keeping the PIN and encrypted-backup password confidential. A backup password is needed for recovery; Apenkoder Software cannot recover a forgotten backup password.

7. NO WARRANTY
Apen Review is provided "as is," without warranty of any kind. We do not guarantee the app will be error-free, uninterrupted, or fit for any particular purpose beyond basic business record-keeping.

8. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
To the fullest extent permitted by Kenyan law, Apenkoder Software shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential loss — including lost income, lost data, or business decisions — arising from your use of this app.

9. CHANGES TO THESE TERMS
We may update these Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of the app after an update means you accept the revised terms. This corrected Apen Review document requires acceptance in the app before you continue, including if you accepted an earlier document.

10. GOVERNING LAW
These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Kenya.
